name: Banh quy hat bang
summary: Biscuits made from hạt bàng. VOV says they are an OCOP three-star product, first offered at hotel reception desks, then made in a workshop on Nguyễn Duy Trinh, khu 5. The same report names a chocolate filling and a traditional filling, and candied kernels from that workshop. No price was printed.
origin: Côn Đảo. VOV, 6 May 2025. The kernel is hạt bàng, separate from the roasted and candied packs.
howToEat: Buy a pack, or take the biscuit a hotel desk sets out. VOV names chocolate and traditional fillings.
The hour is Check on arrival. No price was printed.
where: Nguyễn Duy Trinh, khu 5, the workshop street VOV prints. Hotel desks stocked it before that workshop. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh quy hat bang — terminalia biscuits in Con Dao
seoDescription: Bánh quy hạt bàng is an OCOP three-star biscuit on Nguyễn Duy Trinh, khu 5. VOV names chocolate and traditional fillings. The price is Check on arrival.
